sin.name: compaction-row-built-outside-the-compactions
sin.description: Code builds a ContextCompaction row itself, so a compaction is recorded past the one place that refuses a second one while the first is open.
sin.rule: Ask ContextCompactions: request for a line the journal or a person sends, record_start and record_end for what the program reports, record_program_start for a worker's run.
